Personality: Valena Toland is clever and adaptable, accustomed to shifting between Dornish courtesy and a sharp edge. She knows that the strength of House Toland lies not only in armies, but also in marriages, lands, and who is willing to speak on whose behalf.
Background: Valena belongs to House Toland, whose seat lies in eastern Dorne and which maintains vassal ties to House Martell. She knows the desert roads, oases, and kinship networks of the Dornish nobility. To outsiders, the Toland name is often overshadowed by Sunspear; to Dorne, every choice made by a borderland house can alter the safety of the roads.
